description: Export a run's hash-chained audit entries (prev_hash, hash, redacted args) with the Merkle root, for disputes and questionnaires. Verify offline with sha256(prev_hash + canonical(entry)). Requires an account key.

runId.description: the X-Run-Id your agent sent with the calls; one run is one agent session
